title: Pin ci.yml's named packages so a deleted path fails the local gate
description:
Found by the pwp close-out (tick 8vl, attempt 11), and independently by the final review (sx5, attempt 10) from the other direction.

Five integrated gates stayed green while .github/workflows/ci.yml named ./internal/herd/collect, a package tick nkf had deleted. The gate runs 'go test -short ./...', which compiles only what exists, so a stale path in a workflow file cannot fail it. The break only surfaced when the epic's PR could not go green.

Add a small Go test that parses the 'go test' steps in .github/workflows/*.yml and asserts every ./pkg/... pattern they name resolves to a directory that exists. It would have failed the FIRST gate after nkf merged, and it costs one file.

Scope it to package patterns in go test invocations; do not attempt to validate the whole workflow schema.
acceptance_criteria: A test fails when a .github/workflows go test step names a package path that does not exist in the tree, proven by adding such a path in the test's own fixture; the test passes against the current workflows
